title: Checks for the usage of the to_be_bytes method and/or the function from_be_bytes.
summary: To ensure use of little-endian or the target’s endianness rather than big-endian. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for usage of _.and_then(|x| Some(y)), _.and_then(|x| Ok(y)) or _.or_else(|x| Err(y)).
summary: This can be written more concisely as _.map(|x| y) or _.map_err(|x| y). Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.
